annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation binds applicants for and holders of type-certificates and design/production organisations (design approval holders, producers of UAS, CMUs and components), UAS operators, and Member States' competent authorities, and is binding on all Member States.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: All natural or legal persons that have applied for or hold a type-certificate, restricted type-certificate, supplemental type-certificate, European Technical Standard Order (ETSO) authorisation, major repair design approval or any other relevant approval
annotation.dates_quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union. It shall apply from 1 May 2025.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: amending Regulation (EU) No 748/2012 as regards the initial airworthiness of unmanned aircraft systems subject to certification
